text:
Maria: Quick thread — profiler on TP=8 job shows repeated all-reduce stalls between transformer layers. msg sizes ~48KB frequently, NCCL ring latency dominates. attaching perf trace and some logs. cc @Kai @AJ

AJ: Can you paste the flamegraph/trace here or link? is it at chunk boundaries or per-layer? :eyes:

Maria: Uploaded the trace, main symptom is short all-reduce windows that don't overlap with compute — looks serialized. sample: `allreduce_wait 1.2ms` spikes every 3rd layer. link in thread below.

InfraBot: perf trace uploaded: https://perf.internal/trace/1753127801 (profiles: nccl, kernels, kvcache)

Kai: 48KB is a nasty sweet spot — ring startup/shp cost wins for larger msgs but loses here. tree algo pays fewer hops for small msgs. two quick options: pack smaller tensors to increase msg size >128-256KB OR try NCCL tree algorithm to lower per-hop latency.

Sophie: Micro-batching helped a bit before (x4 microbatches) but memory went up. Another approach: pack small gradient chunks across microbatches into a single all-reduce per shard so we keep step semantics but increase message size. we did a prototype in 2023. :thinking:

Tim: Quick test knobs: `export NCCL_ALGO=tree` and try `NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS=4` + `NCCL_NTHREADS=4`. also check `NCCL_TOPO_DUMP_FILE` for topology behavior.

Devon: Also flag: KV cache behavior could be interfering. We saw eviction/serialize work that races with comm and creates tail latency. Are there background cache flush events in the trace?

AJ: Good call — can we enable kvcache evictions in trace metadata? add `cache_evictions:true` and a marker around eviction events.

Maria: Ran three runs this morning: baseline, pack-small-tensors, force-tree-algo. Quick numbers (TP step lat):
```
baseline (ring, no-pack): 28.6ms
pack-small (pack < 128KB across microbatches): 24.8ms (-13%)
force-tree (NCCL_ALGO=tree): 22.3ms (-22%)
```
pack-small used microbatches=2, minimal mem overhead. force-tree shows best latency but we need to confirm stability across topologies.

Kai: Nice. Can you share the exact runtime flag we toggled? also we should ensure kernel selection still picks the fused reduce kernels — packing changes tensor shapes which can affect kernel choice.

Maria: runtime flags I used:
```text
--tp-allreduce-pack=true
--allreduce-pack-threshold=128KB
--tp-microbatches=2
```
Command: `python -m perf.harness --model gpt-small --tp 8 --batch 1 --config runtime_flags.json`

Sophie: We need CI perf job and a regression alert. please add a perf test for small message distribution (many small tensors) vs packed. Add an eval harness that runs on Dedicated pool.

Maria: Will open PR for `tp-allreduce-pack` implementation + perf job. plan: A/B in Dedicated then private deploy.

Tim: Also watch kernel selection: packed allreduce might pick a different reduce kernel. make sure we maintain a fallback path. some fused kernels prefer power-of-two channels; pack alignment matters.

InfraBot: Created issue INF-4823: "TP allreduce message packing and scheduling investigation" and kicked off perf job 1753127900 (status: queued).

AJ: Let's sync 30min tomorrow to decide default threshold and safety limits. When's good?

Devon: 10:00 AM PT works for me.

Maria: Added calendar invite for 10:00 AM PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
